titleEnglish: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum — Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan

verses.en: O the Ever-Living, The Ever-Lasting One!

verses.ar:
Ya Raḥīmu Ya Raḥman, Ya ‘adilu Ya Mannan
Ya Ḥafiẓu Ya Sattar, Ya Wahidu Ya Ghaffar
Ya Maliku Ya Razzaq, Tu khaliq-e- har khallaq
Har raz tujhe ma‘lum (2)
verses.en:
O the Most-Merciful, the Beneficent, O the Just One, O the Bestower (of blessings)
O the Protecting One, the Concealing One, O the Only-One, the Forgiver
O the One who owns everything, who provides for everyone, You are the Creator of all creators
You know every secret

verses.ar:
Be misl hai to la-raib, Tu pak hai to be-aib
Tu zist ka hai unwan, Tu sakhir-e-har udwan
Teri zat hai azz-o-jal, Tu har mushkil ka hal
Har samt hai teri dhum (2)
verses.en:
You are the quintessence of certainty, You are pure and immaculate
All life begins from You, You are the Subduer of all enemies
Your being is eternal, You are the solution to every problem
You are known all over

verses.ar:
Wo Nabiyon Ka Sardaar, Har Aalam Ka Mukhtaar
Tu Saaz Hai Wo Aawaz, Tu Raaz Wo Mehram Raaz
Tu Lafz Hai Wo Farhang, Tu Haakim Wo Aurang
Tu Lazim Wo Malzoom (2)
verses.en:
He is the chief of all Prophets, The sovereign of every world
You are the instrument, he is the voice, You are the secret, he is the keeper of secrets
You are the word, he is the meaning; You are the ruler, he is the throne
You are the essential, he is the one entrusted

verses.ar:
Mein Naqsh Hoon Tu Naqqaash, Tu Mul'im Mein Mein Qallash
Mein Aabid Tu Maabood, Mein Sajid Tu Masjood
Mein Jism Aur Tu Dam, Tera Zikr Ilaj-E-Gham
Kyun Dil Ho Mera Maghmor (2)
verses.en:
I am the image, You are the painter, You are the teacher, I am the unruly student
I am the worshipper, You are the worshipped, I am the one who prostrates, You are the one prostrated to
I am the body and You are the breath; Your remembrance is the cure for grief
Why should my heart ever be sorrowful?

verses.ar:
Tanzeel Tera Paigaam, Hai Khaas Tera Inaam
Hai Dar Ki Yeh Akseer, Imaan Iski Taseer
Hai Silsilaey Ehsaas, Al-Hamd Se Ta Wan-Naas
Hai Saaf Is Ka Mafhoom (2)
verses.en:
Your revelation is a message, Your gift is a special prize.
It is an elixir from the Divine Threshold; its essence is faith.
It is a continuous flow of spiritual awareness—from Al-Hamd to An-Nas.
Its meaning is clear.
